description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's object name disambiguation features. It contains multiple test cases that create various Git objects (blobs, trees, commits, tags) with overlapping prefixes and then run commands like rev-parse and git-log to check how Git handles ambiguous object names, disambiguation, and error reporting.

methods.name: test_cmp_failed_rev_parse
methods.description: Checks that rev-parse fails for a given revision and compares output to expected snapshot.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, executing a series of Git commands and assertions.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to fail, used to check handling of ambiguous or problematic input.
